items.title: Data clean room
clues: I am a safe meeting place.
Two companies bring their data to me.
They can match audiences without sharing raw records.
Strict rules decide what can leave me.
items.why: A clean room lets companies match data under strict controls.

items.title: First-party data
clues: I come straight from the source.
A company collects me from its own customers.
Nobody else collected me on its behalf.
items.why: First-party data is collected directly by the company that uses it.

items.title: Identity graph
clues: I am a map of connections.
I link devices and IDs that belong together.
One household may have many entries in me.
Marketers use me to recognise the same person across screens.
items.why: An identity graph links identifiers that belong to the same person or household.
